Our Mahad Manufacturing Facility was set up in 2020. Any new greenfield facility takes time to stabilize
operation in terms of yield and quality. Since the launch of our Mahad Manufacturing Facility, the
agrochemical industry experienced unprecedented events such as COVID related disruptions and de-stocking
in the global markets resulting in demand fluctuation. Our Mahad Manufacturing Facility was also shutdown
from October 27, 2023 to May 3, 2024 pursuant to closure directions issued by the MPCB on October 27,
2023, following a gas leakage incident that occurred on October 5, 2023, at our Mahad Manufacturing
Facility. The incident involved the release of H₂S and SO₂ gases during the DETC manufacturing process,
the Mahad Manufacturing Facility was granted approval to resume operations on May 3, 2024, subject to the
fulfillment of certain conditions imposed by the MPCB. The combination of all these factors led to a delay in
stabilizing our operations at our greenfield Mahad Manufacturing Facility and low capacity utilisation at, and
losses from, Mahad Manufacturing Facility during Fiscal 2025 and Fiscal 2024. In Fiscal 2026, our capacity
utilisation at Mahad Manufacturing Facility has increased as compared to Fiscal 2025 and Fiscal 2024.
Further, during Fiscal 2026, our losses before exceptional items and tax from the Mahad Manufacturing
Facility was ₹ 121.72 million as compared to losses before exceptional items and tax of ₹ 157.66 million and
₹ 227.73 million during Fiscal 2025 and Fiscal 2024, respectively.
